_note: SECTION 51: centralised rate configuration. Legislation is NEVER hard-coded into a component. Update this file when rates change and every calculator follows. Each rate set carries last_verified; while it is null the calculators render a prominent unverified banner and the build warns. Nothing here has been checked against the current statute by this build.

ontario.name: Ontario Land Transfer Tax
ontario._note: Brackets are marginal: each rate applies only to the portion of the price inside that band. The top band applies to a conveyance of land containing one or two single family residences.

brackets.note: One or two single family residences

first_time_buyer_rebate.eligibility_summary: Must be at least 18, must not have owned a home or interest in a home anywhere in the world, and a spouse must not have owned one while being your spouse. The home must be occupied as a principal residence within nine months. Application is generally made through your lawyer at closing.

toronto.name: Toronto Municipal Land Transfer Tax
toronto._note: Charged IN ADDITION to the provincial tax on property within the City of Toronto. The upper bands were expanded for high value residential conveyances; verify the current schedule before relying on it.

first_time_buyer_rebate.eligibility_summary: Broadly mirrors the provincial first-time buyer refund and is claimed separately. Confirm current eligibility and maximum with the City of Toronto.

closing_cost_defaults._note: Starting figures for the buying cost calculator only. They are editable by the user in the interface and are not represented as quotes.

minimum_down_payment._note: Federally regulated minimums. Tiered: five percent on the portion to $500,000, ten percent on the portion between $500,000 and $1,500,000, twenty percent at or above $1,500,000.

default_insurance_premium._note: CMHC premium bands on the insurable portion, by loan to value.
